name: learning
description: File-authored course bundles with Markdown lessons, independent multi-tab study, durable progress, and resource-based agent context.

screenshots.caption: A lesson with theory, a test and practice

adapt.description: Adapt one lesson in the current Learning Studio course
adapt.prompt:
Adapt $ARGUMENTS in the attached Learning Studio course. Use learning_course action get with a
focused lesson_id or step_id to inspect content and learner evidence. Use action guide if needed.
Patch only affected files in the canonical bundle returned as manifest_path, then validate and
activate the same root course.json. Preserve stable ids and unrelated material. Changing a quiz's
question, options or correct answer, a practice prompt or criteria, or flashcard content invalidates
that step's earlier evidence. Theory, quiz explanations and practice hints can be polished without
resetting an unchanged assessed task. Do not preserve mastery for a task whose requirements changed.

create.description: Build a personal adaptive course in Learning Studio
create.prompt:
Build a Learning Studio course for $ARGUMENTS. Call learning_course action guide for the format and
quality checklist. Use preferences already given; ask together for missing preferences that change
the route. Do not ask about generation strategy: prepare one complete module at a time. Write a
compact outline JSON and use action draft with outline_path to create the pending hierarchy. Author
every lesson in the first module in depth, then validate and activate the course. The mini app can
request later modules as the learner advances; inspect generation failures if the tutor wake does
not reach an agent. Keep long prose in Markdown.

lesson.description: Generate one pending lesson from the current course outline
lesson.prompt:
Prepare lesson $ARGUMENTS in the attached Learning Studio course. Use learning_course action get for
the course and lesson and action guide for the exact format. Inspect earlier learner attempts and
reviews. Edit only this lesson in the canonical bundle returned as manifest_path, then validate and
activate the same course. Preserve stable ids and unrelated content. Preparing a lesson does not
complete it. Normal study requests whole modules through the tutor-generation flow; this command is
for an explicit request to work on a particular lesson.
